decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider from Coinbase Commerce to Transak does not alter secondary-sale royalties, prize-pool destinations, or referral-ticket behavior.
The Transak provider choice does not change the Brevo transactional-email provider or email-delivery behavior.
The fiat on-ramp provider decision does not change email magic-link authentication or its dashboard-access purpose.
The source decision concerns only the fiat on-ramp provider and does not modify NFT badge definitions or icon rules.
Selecting Transak for fiat purchases does not change the reward allocation used when a primary mint has no referral code.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not alter ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw reset rules.
The provider selection does not affect random winner selection, ticket weighting, or block-specific eligibility.
The Transak decision does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw condition, or royalty contribution rule.
